_comment: Copy this file to themes/<your-theme-id>.json and fill in every field below. JSON has no comment syntax, so this _comment key is ignored by themeLoader.js — leave it or delete it, your choice. See themes/README.md for the full field reference.
displayName: Human-readable name shown in banners, notifications, and the admin UI
tagline: A short closing line used in notifications, e.g. an emoji sign-off
author: Your name or studio
bannerTitle: SHORT ALL-CAPS TITLE FOR THE CLI BANNER

phase1.name: Phase 1 — Baseline
phase1.prompt: Describe the starting scene in vivid, specific visual detail for the video generation model.

phase2.name: Phase 2 — Transformation
phase2.prompt: Describe the transformation/twist that happens to the subject from phase 1.
phase2.negativePrompt: distorted, cartoon, low quality, morphing artifacts

phase3.name: Phase 3 — Resolution
phase3.prompt: Describe how the scene resolves or returns to its baseline state.

ambient.name: Ambient / Baseline Audio
ambient.prompt: Describe the ambient soundscape matching phase 1.

transformation.name: Transformation Audio
transformation.prompt: Describe the sound design for the transformation moment matching phase 2.

music.name: Cinematic Score
music.prompt: Describe the musical score arc across all three phases, e.g. [opening] [rising tension] [climax] [resolution].

overlay.primaryText: Primary on-screen text (e.g. in a local script/language). Leave empty string if not needed.
overlay.secondaryText: Secondary on-screen text (e.g. English translation or tagline).

youtube.title: YouTube video title
youtube.description: Full YouTube description, including hashtags. Use \n for line breaks.

notifications.whatsappComplete:
✅ {displayName} video COMPLETE!
⏱️ Time: {duration} mins
📱 {exportCount} platform versions ready
{tagline}
